alt: Two panels compare an ideal point source with distance r and 2r and an extended three-bar fixture with overlapping rays and a canopy sampling grid. The point-source panel labels a one-quarter irradiance ratio under ideal assumptions; the fixture panel warns that real PPFD must be mapped.
